body: Fun extra language: every string of ours in emoji on both clients (placeholders such as names, e-mails and counts stay data). Listed last in the language picker as a normal entry, labelled like the other non-English languages with "(Emoji)" in the current language, so a user can always find the way back. Private language code (ISO 639 local-use range, e.g. qaa); dates and numbers format as English. crossClient pairing and all string guards cover it as the tenth locale.
title: Emoji language: a tenth language in emoji, last in the picker
